target.claim: Construct nontrivial pure Yang--Mills theory on R^4 for every compact simple gauge group and prove a positive Hamiltonian mass gap.

proved_restricted.claim: Exact 2^4 cubical quotient, retained coarse-flux rank, and fiber dimensions.
proved_restricted.scope: finite tangent complex tensored with su(2)

proved_restricted.claim: Certified quotient and fiber coercivity lower bound 2.
proved_restricted.scope: quadratic tangent action on the frozen block

proved_restricted.claim: Gaussian centered conditional-fiber covariance is independent of retained data.
The exact local SU(2) heat-kernel block action is an analytic perturbation of the tangent quadratic action with finite-block small-field derivative bounds.
proved_restricted.scope: one local orbit chart, sufficiently small heat time and curvature

proved_restricted.claim: After nonlinear minimizer centering, a sufficiently small local good-fiber tube has Wasserstein response below one.
proved_restricted.scope: one common convex local fiber chart with existential constants

proved_conditional.claim: A scaled Hessian remainder eta<2 leaves nonlinear fiber strong-convexity margin (2-eta)/t.
A centered cross-gradient bound chi/t implies quotient-fiber W2 response at most chi/(2-eta).

numerical.claim: Fiber minimum eigenvalue is approximately 3.438447187 and full-coordinate response norm is approximately 0.393174006.

open_frontier.claim: Global gauge-covariant nonlinear disintegration and orbit atlas.
One-step and multistep stability for generated effective actions.
Dependent bad-block and topology polymer theorem.
Weak-to-massive nonperturbative crossover of the retained base.
Nontrivial regulator-independent OS continuum theory and spectral transfer.

forbidden_inferences: Finite-block coercivity is not a physical mass gap.
Local small-field control is not a full-measure theorem.
Existence of sufficiently small local constants is not cutoff-uniform RG iteration.
Centered fiber contraction does not establish terminal base rigidity.
A tangent su(2) theorem is not a nonlinear SU(2) continuum construction.
